fingerprint.description: Looks up price and availability for up to 30 product identifiers at the Distributors you name in `sources`. Each source is a Distributor from `GET /v1/distributors`, referenced by its `id`. Stored Distributor credentials are applied for you; they are never part of the request. An id that is unknown, disabled, deleted or belongs to another account, or whose stored credentials are incomplete or unreadable, fails the request with `422` `ERR_PNA_REQUEST_INVALID` and the detail `sources[i] has no stored credentials`. Each source holds the Distributor `id` and, optionally, a `reference`; nothing else. Each Distributor may be listed once, and at most 10 sources are accepted. The request body is limited to 1 MB. The response lists one entry per offer, plus one entry per Distributor that failed. `distributor.id` is the source `id` you sent and `distributor.name` is its integration: - `dandh`: D&H - `dickerdata`: Dicker Data - `ingrammicrorest`: Ingram Micro - `synnex`: TD SYNNEX - `techdataeu`: Tech Data Europe A failed Distributor (for example because it rejected the stored credentials) does not fail the request: its entry has `error` set and every offer field `null`, and the other Distributors are still returned. `error.code` and `error.message` are one of: - `ERR_DISTRIBUTOR_CREDENTIALS_INVALID`, "The distributor rejected the stored credentials" - `ERR_DISTRIBUTOR_REQUEST_INVALID`, "The distributor rejected the request", for example an unsupported country - `ERR_DISTRIBUTOR_UNAVAILABLE`, "The distributor did not return a usable response", when it failed or did not answer `reference` on a source is optional. Whatever object you send is returned unchanged as `reference` on that source's entries, so you can correlate results with your own records. Money fields end in `_decimal` and are decimal strings in major currency units, for example `"331.91"`. `currency_iso` is `null` when the Distributor does not report a currency. `msrp_decimal` is `"0.00"` when the Distributor does not report an MSRP.
